_comment: Bass Sentry LoRa Configuration - Recommended for venues with WiFi issues
_description: Balanced configuration: good range (2-5km) with fast data rate

lora._frequency_comment: 915 MHz for US/Canada. Use 868 for Europe, 433 for Asia
lora._tx_power_comment: 20 dBm = good range. Max is 23 dBm (longer range, more power)
lora._spreading_factor_comment: SF7 = fast (2-5km range). Use SF10-12 for longer range (5-20km)
lora._node_id_comment: Change this for each remote node: 1, 2, 3, etc.

_usage.remote_nodes: Set node_id to 1, 2, 3, ... for each remote node
_usage.range_tradeoff: SF7 = 2-5km fast. SF12 = 5-20km slower (but still fast enough for bass!)
_usage.power_tradeoff: 20 dBm = good range. 23 dBm = max range (uses more battery)

_antenna_tips.placement: Mount antenna vertically, as high as possible
_antenna_tips.line_of_sight: Best performance with clear line of sight
_antenna_tips.obstacles: LoRa penetrates concrete/metal better than WiFi
_antenna_tips.never: NEVER power on without antenna attached!

_troubleshooting.no_connection: Check frequency matches region (915 US, 868 EU, 433 Asia)
